configuration: BEGIN READ ONLY; SELECT version() AS engine, current_setting('server_version_num') AS server_version_num, (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',name,'value_sha256',encode(sha256(convert_to(setting,'UTF8')),'hex'),'setting',CASE WHEN name = ANY(ARRAY['server_version','server_encoding','lc_collate','lc_ctype','TimeZone','shared_preload_libraries','wal_level','max_connections','max_replication_slots','max_wal_senders','max_worker_processes','max_logical_replication_workers','max_parallel_workers','max_parallel_workers_per_gather','max_slot_wal_keep_size','cron.database_name','cron.launch_active_jobs','pg_net.database_name','search_path','row_security','password_encryption','default_transaction_isolation','default_transaction_read_only','statement_timeout','lock_timeout','idle_in_transaction_session_timeout','shared_buffers','effective_cache_size','work_mem','maintenance_work_mem','default_toast_compression','track_functions','track_activity_query_size','log_statement','log_min_error_statement','log_min_messages','ssl','ssl_min_protocol_version','jit','synchronous_commit','max_locks_per_transaction']) THEN setting ELSE NULL END,'unit',unit,'context',context,'source',source,'pending_restart',pending_restart) ORDER BY name) FROM pg_settings) AS settings; COMMIT;
managed_ledgers: BEGIN READ ONLY; SELECT jsonb_build_object('engine',version(),'application_ledger_count',(SELECT count(*) FROM supabase_migrations.schema_migrations),'application_ledger_max',(SELECT max(version) FROM supabase_migrations.schema_migrations),'auth',(SELECT jsonb_agg(version ORDER BY version) FROM auth.schema_migrations),'storage',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'name',name,'hash',hash) ORDER BY id) FROM storage.migrations),'realtime',(SELECT jsonb_agg(version::text ORDER BY version) FROM realtime.schema_migrations)) AS metadata; COMMIT;
